label: At the reading world w, whatever is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to something other…, by Universal instantiation…
rule: Universal instantiation, conjunction elimination and modus ponens
meaning: If y is simply prior to x, x depends for its being on y (necessary direction of the dependence analysis of priority, reused from causal maps batch 1); both are actual concreta; so y grounds x. The distinctness hypothesis of the target is not used.
